templates.pat: Many scientific and data-intensive analyses are a chain of command-line tools that pass data to each other as files, rather than through databases or APIs. These pipelines run over thousands of inputs, each step can take hours, and each tool needs specific software versions. Running that reliably means moving files to where the work runs, splitting the work into parallel jobs, submitting them to a cluster or cloud, retrying failures, and keeping track of what has already finished. Nextflow handles this for you. You write each step in any language, and Nextflow stages each task's input files into its own working directory, whether they are stored locally or in cloud object storage. It runs every file through the pipeline in parallel, can give each task its own container, and runs the same pipeline on a laptop, an HPC cluster, or the cloud with only a configuration change. There is no server to deploy, and if a run fails, {{1}} picks up where it stopped.
templates.zh: 许多科学与数据密集型分析都是由命令行工具串联而成，工具之间通过文件而非数据库或 API 传递数据。这类流程要处理成千上万的输入，每一步可能耗时数小时，而且每个工具都需要特定的软件版本。要可靠地跑起来，就得把文件搬到实际计算的位置、把工作拆成并行作业、提交到集群或云端、重试失败的作业，并跟踪哪些已经完成。Nextflow 会替你处理这些。你可以用任意语言编写每一步，Nextflow 会把每个任务的输入文件暂存到它自己的工作目录，无论文件存储在本地还是云对象存储。它会并行处理每个文件，可以让每个任务拥有自己的容器，并且只需改一份配置，就能在笔记本、HPC 集群或云端运行同一套流程。无需部署服务器；如果运行失败，{{1}} 会从上次中断处继续。
